stories.title: Binance hack: Investigators in a 'cat and mouse game' to recover $6.3 billion in stolen funds
stories.summary: More than $6 billion in crypto was stolen from Binance, with blockchain-intelligence firms linking the hack to North Korea’s TraderTraitor group. Experts say that hackers use various obfuscation techniques to mask the movement of the crypto. stories.title: 'Bad time to troll': Binance co-founder Zhao asks Musk for support after hack
stories.summary: Binance's cofounder Changpeng Zhao urged Elon Musk to stop mocking the exchange after it suffered a $6.3 billion hack. The SpaceX and Tesla CEO posted a series of emojis on X which appeared to poke fun at the attack, which has seen $3 billion in crypto assets frozen so far.
